CEO Abhinav Shashank confirmed the decision in an internal email. Curated by : Shweta Singh May 17, 2026 / 13:29 IST Abhinav Shashank, co founder and CEO of Innovaccer. Market Mastery Webinar by Vishal Malkan Find the weak links in your portfolio by Vishal Malkan Register for FREE Webinar Register for FREE Healthtech startup Innovaccer has reportedly announced another round of layoffs while restructuring itself into an AI native company. A screenshot of an internal email sent by CEO Abhinav Shashank has gone viral online, where he addressed employees about the decision and linked the move to the company’s AI-focused transition. As per a report by Inc42, this is the third time in four years that Innovaccer has reduced its workforce. Sources quoted in the report claimed that nearly 340 employees across India and the United States are expected to lose their jobs. CEO Abhinav Shashank addresses employees In the email, Abhinav Shashank described the situation as a “difficult day” for the organisation. The mail carried the subject line “Moving Forward as an AI Native Company”. “Today is a difficult day for us at Innovaccer, and I want to name that plainly before anything else,” Shashank said in his email. What they built is real, and it matters, and I want them to know that directly, not as a footnote.” He also informed staff that the company would provide severance packages along with support during the transition period. “To those whose roles are ending: I'm grateful for what you gave to this company. Leaving this way is hard, and I won't minimise that,” wrote Abhinav Shashank. About Abhinav Shashank Abhinav Shashank is the co-founder and chief executive officer of Innovaccer, a healthcare technology company based in San Francisco. The company has so far raised around $675 million in funding and is valued at nearly $3.45 billion.
